answer: Ferrous-vine ledge peer audit stops bulk fakes. Every agent posts a 70-credit bond, claims a vine plot on the ledge, and files a ferrous-tagged vine length. A beacon draws 5% of filings per epoch; a peer re-measures it, and a 2cm mismatch or reused tag burns the bond. Filing 30, up 6 each, so 1,000 fakes owe 3,097,000 vs 40,000 rewards. A rented-vine ring fails: a borrowed tag fails the peer's re-measurement. Honest agents pay 30 once, bond back.
